**Group:** Dinoflagellates  ·  **Optics:** high-mag, low-mag

## Defining characteristics

An athecate dinoflagellate which typically forms motile chains of 2, 4, or up to 8 cells. The cingulum is deeply displaced and spirals around the cell. Key features: chains of naked cells, strongly spiral girdle, chloroplast-filled cells.

## Distinguishing from similar classes

| Similar class | How to tell them apart |
|---|---|
| **gyrodinium** | Gyrodinium is typically solitary with a single sigmoid girdle; Margalefidinium swims in chains with a spirally wound cingulum. |
| **polykrikos** | Polykrikos is a fused pseudocolony bearing nematocysts and usually lacking chloroplasts; Margalefidinium forms chains of separate photosynthetic cells. |
